// Generated from packages/capability-merge/workflows/merge_item/merge_item.workflow-source.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
digraph merge_item {
    label = "merge_item"
    workflow_source = "packages/capability-merge/workflows/merge_item/merge_item.workflow-source.mjs"
    typed_action_transport_mode = "enforced"
    attempt_merge [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.attempt_deterministic" label="Attempt deterministic merge" output_format="json" outputs="merge_status,merge_stdout,merge_stderr,merge_worktree_dir,merge_branch_head_sha,merged_head_sha" action_repo="${repo}" action_branch="${branch}" action_branch_head_sha="${merge_branch_head_sha}" action_merge_worktree_dir="${merge_worktree_dir}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    build_conflict_packet [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.build_conflict_packet" label="Build conflict packet" output_format="json" outputs="conflict_packet_path,conflict_packet_id,conflict_packet_schema_version,conflict_packet_storage_class" action_repo="${repo}" action_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="merge_item" action_node_id="build_conflict_packet" action_branch="${branch}" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_merge_candidates="${merge_candidates}" action_merge_stderr="${merge_stderr}" action_target_repo="${gh_repo}" action_worktree_dir="${merge_worktree_dir}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    cleanup_failed_merge [type="tool" governance="irreversible" label="Cleanup failed merge state" output_key="__cleanup_failed_merge_result" prompt="# hatch:no-inline-script-ok\ngit -C \"${merge_worktree_dir}\" merge --abort >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\ngit -C \"${merge_worktree_dir}\" rebase --abort >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    cleanup_merge_worktree [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.cleanup_worktree" label="Cleanup merge worktree" output_key="__cleanup_merge_worktree_result" action_repo="${repo}" action_merge_worktree_dir="${merge_worktree_dir}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    close_issue [type="tool" governance="irreversible" label="Close merged issue" output_key="__close_issue_result" prompt="# hatch:no-inline-script-ok\nif [ '${final_merge_status}' = 'merged' ] || [ '${final_merge_status}' = 'already_merged' ]; then gh issue close ${issue_number} --repo ${gh_repo} --reason completed || true; fi" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    done [shape="Msquare" recovery_sink_type="terminal"]
    encode_integration_command [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.encode_base64" label="Encode integration command" output_key="integration_command_b64" action_value="${integration_command}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    encode_merge_notes [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.encode_base64" label="Encode merge notes" output_key="merge_notes_b64" action_value="${merge_stderr} ${resolution_notes}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    extract_merge [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.extract_item" label="Extract merge" output_format="json" outputs="issue_number,branch,worktree_dir" action_merge_item="${merge_item}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    finalize_gate [shape="diamond" label="Finalize status"]
    finalize_merge_commit [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.finalize_commit" label="Finalize merge commit if pending" output_format="json" outputs="finalize_status,finalize_reason" action_repo="${repo}" action_merge_worktree_dir="${merge_worktree_dir}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    integration [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.run_integration" label="Integration checks (non-blocking)" output_key="integration_result" output_format="json" outputs="integration_command,integration_exit_code,integration_stdout,integration_stderr,integration_duration_ms,integration_legacy_text" action_repo="${repo}" action_integration_command_b64="${integration_command_b64}" action_merge_worktree_dir="${merge_worktree_dir}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    load_merge_resolve_conflict_retry_task_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load retry resolve-conflict task prompt" output_key="merge_resolve_conflict_retry_task_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/merge_resolver/retry_resolve_conflict.md" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    load_merge_resolve_conflict_task_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load resolve-conflict task prompt" output_key="merge_resolve_conflict_task_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/merge_resolver/resolve_conflict.md" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    load_merge_resolver_system_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load merge resolver system prompt" output_key="merge_resolver_system_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/merge_resolver/system.md" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    merge_gate [shape="diamond" label="Merge status"]
    rebase_gate [shape="diamond" label="Rebase status"]
    rebase_on_main [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.rebase_on_main" label="Rebase branch on main" output_format="json" outputs="rebase_status,rebase_stdout,rebase_stderr,merge_worktree_dir,merge_branch_head_sha" action_repo="${repo}" action_branch="${branch}" action_merge_worktree_dir="${merge_worktree_dir}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    report [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.build_report" label="Report merge" output_key="merge_result" output_format="json" outputs="issue_number,branch,merge_status,notes,path_taken,hatch.merge.resolver" action_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_branch="${branch}" action_integration_result="${integration_result}" action_merge_resolver="${resolution_source}" action_merge_status="${final_merge_status}" action_notes_b64="${merge_notes_b64}" action_path_taken="merge" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    resolution_gate [shape="diamond" label="Conflict resolved?"]
    resolve_conflict [class="merge_resolver" benchmark_job_id="goal.execute.merge.resolve_conflict" llm_path_id="capability.merge_item.resolve_conflict" prompt_version="2026-03-09.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="goal.execute.merge" label="Resolve merge conflict" reasoning_effort="low" timeout="45m" prompt="${merge_resolver_system_prompt}\n\nLoad and follow ${capability_merge_skills}/merge_conflict_resolver/SKILL.md.\n\n${merge_resolve_conflict_task_prompt}\n\nConflict packet: ${conflict_packet_path}" prompt_input_keys="capability_merge_skills,conflict_packet_path" prompt_source="merge_resolve_conflict_task_prompt" recovery_owner="supervisor" system_prompt_source="merge_resolver_system_prompt" task_prompt_source="merge_resolve_conflict_task_prompt" workdir="${merge_worktree_dir}"]
    retry_resolve_conflict [class="merge_resolver" benchmark_job_id="goal.execute.merge.retry_resolve_conflict" llm_path_id="capability.merge_item.retry_resolve_conflict" prompt_version="2026-03-09.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="goal.execute.merge" label="Retry: resolve merge conflict" reasoning_effort="low" timeout="60m" prompt="${merge_resolver_system_prompt}\n\nLoad and follow ${capability_merge_skills}/merge_conflict_resolver/SKILL.md.\n\n${merge_resolve_conflict_retry_task_prompt}\n\nConflict packet: ${conflict_packet_path}" prompt_input_keys="capability_merge_skills,conflict_packet_path" prompt_source="merge_resolve_conflict_retry_task_prompt" recovery_owner="supervisor" system_prompt_source="merge_resolver_system_prompt" task_prompt_source="merge_resolve_conflict_retry_task_prompt" workdir="${merge_worktree_dir}"]
    route_error_to_resolver [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Route error to resolver" prompt=":" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_resolution_source_deterministic [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set merge resolver: deterministic" output_key="resolution_source" prompt="printf 'deterministic'" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_resolution_source_llm [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set merge resolver: llm" output_key="resolution_source" prompt="printf 'llm'" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_status_already [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set already-merged status" output_key="final_merge_status" prompt="printf 'already_merged'" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_status_failed [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set failed status" output_key="final_merge_status" prompt="printf 'failed'" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_status_merged [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set merged status" output_key="final_merge_status" prompt="printf 'merged'" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    setup_merge_worktree [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.setup_worktree" label="Setup merge worktree" output_format="json" outputs="setup,reason,merge_worktree_dir,merge_base_ref,merge_branch_head_sha" action_repo="${repo}" action_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="merge-item" action_branch="${branch}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    start [shape="Mdiamond"]
    verify_resolution [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="merge.verify_resolution" label="Verify conflict resolved" output_format="json" outputs="resolution_status,resolution_notes" action_repo="${repo}" action_branch="${branch}" action_merge_worktree_dir="${merge_worktree_dir}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    encode_integration_command -> integration -> close_issue -> encode_merge_notes -> report -> cleanup_merge_worktree -> done
    set_resolution_source_llm -> build_conflict_packet -> resolve_conflict -> finalize_merge_commit -> finalize_gate
    set_status_merged -> encode_integration_command
    start -> load_merge_resolver_system_prompt -> load_merge_resolve_conflict_task_prompt -> load_merge_resolve_conflict_retry_task_prompt -> extract_merge -> setup_merge_worktree -> rebase_on_main -> rebase_gate
    verify_resolution -> resolution_gate
    attempt_merge -> merge_gate
    cleanup_failed_merge -> encode_integration_command
    finalize_gate -> retry_resolve_conflict [condition="finalize_status!=ok"]
    finalize_gate -> verify_resolution [condition="finalize_status=ok"]
    merge_gate -> route_error_to_resolver [condition="merge_status=error"]
    merge_gate -> set_resolution_source_llm [condition="merge_status=conflict"]
    merge_gate -> set_status_already [condition="merge_status=already_merged"]
    merge_gate -> set_status_merged [condition="merge_status=merged"]
    rebase_gate -> set_resolution_source_deterministic [condition="rebase_status=ready"]
    rebase_gate -> set_resolution_source_llm [condition="rebase_status!=ready"]
    resolution_gate -> set_status_failed [condition="resolution_status!=resolved"]
    resolution_gate -> set_status_merged [condition="resolution_status=resolved"]
    retry_resolve_conflict -> verify_resolution
    route_error_to_resolver -> set_resolution_source_llm
    set_resolution_source_deterministic -> attempt_merge
    set_status_already -> encode_integration_command
    set_status_failed -> cleanup_failed_merge
}
